name: n8n in Orca
description: Open your local or Cloud n8n instance in Orca. Browse workflows, read-only previews, recent runs, and insights in the sidebar.

cover.alt: n8n in Orca on one line, with n8n in signature pink, a tilted n8n-symbol tile, and Local / Cloud connection options.

screenshots.alt: Dark sidebar with sample workflows, a read-only workflow preview, and expanded recent-run details.
screenshots.caption: Expand cards for workflow previews and recent runs. Sample data.

screenshots.alt: Light sidebar with fading dotted workflow cards, instance controls, and a compact version footer.
screenshots.caption: A clear workflow companion in light and dark themes. Sample data.

screenshots.alt: Dark sidebar with a compact expanded seven-day insights grid above the workflow list.
screenshots.caption: Production runs, failures, failure rate, time saved, and average run time. Sample metrics.

screenshots.alt: Light sidebar with five insights metrics in a compact grid and a refresh icon in the header.
screenshots.caption: An expandable overview that keeps workflows in view. Sample metrics.
